integrity: Every claimed operator equality is derived on finite supports and extended by density. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The results concern the canonical coordinate identity, not the unrestricted Banach–Mazur distance or all possible embeddings. The uncountable construction invokes the published Erdős–Ko–Rado and Lovász–Kneser graph theorems. The assessment does not establish uniqueness against unindexed literature.
title: Fractional clique-cover norms and the sharp two-threshold for graph-generated Banach spaces
